meta.name: Yeremia Reynaldo
meta.tagline: I manage a 10,000+ device Mac fleet at CVS Health, then go home and try to automate everything else in my life too.

about: I manage Apple devices at enterprise scale for a Fortune 10 healthcare company, but most of what I actually know I picked up by building things until they worked. I like taking a messy manual process and turning it into something that runs itself, whether that's at work or in my own house. Lately that curiosity has pulled me toward robotics and AI, mostly self-taught, one small project at a time.

outsideOfWork.intro: When I'm not staring at a screen, I'm probably outside. Hiking and camping around Maine with my two dogs, Aspen and Oakley, is my reset button. I also like traveling and trying new food wherever I end up.

currentlyBuilding.title: Raspberry Pi ad blocker
currentlyBuilding.description: Set up a Pi as a network-wide ad blocker so every device on my home network is covered automatically, no per-device app needed.

currentlyBuilding.title: A local NAS
currentlyBuilding.description: Building my own network storage to keep photos and files under my own roof and cut down on paid cloud subscriptions.

currentlyBuilding.title: Learning robotics
currentlyBuilding.description: Teaching myself the basics with the long-term goal of designing and building my own robot from scratch.

currentlyBuilding.title: Automating as much of life as possible
currentlyBuilding.description: If I find myself doing something more than twice, I try to build a way out of doing it a third time. Still a work in progress.

projects.name: Automated Device Refresh & Software Rescoping
projects.summary: Replaced a manual, 15–30 minute per-device software reassignment process with a self-service flow that reads two serial numbers off a form and does the rest.

metrics.label: software entitlements reassigned automatically per device

highlights: Designed and built an end-to-end automation with Power Automate and the Jamf Pro API, no paid tooling required
Flow identifies relevant software groups, filters out base build apps, and transfers entitlements to the replacement device automatically
Real-time notifications to techs, end users, and the Mac engineering team on every run
Took it from idea to MVP in about six weeks, then through a pilot before handing it to the build team in production
Own the process end to end, including documentation and support

projects.name: Offboarding Process Automation
projects.summary: Designing a standalone workflow that handles device offboarding differently depending on why the device is leaving, not just a generic check-in.
highlights: Working with other teams to map out their current offboarding processes before finalizing the design
Techs will submit a serial number, offboarding type, and notes through a simple Microsoft Form
Return to Stock: lowest risk path, device is queued to be wiped and reused
Full Retire: device gets a complete wipe
Lost or Stolen: notes capture context and the device is locked and erased, escalating through security policy automatically

projects.name: AI-Powered Admin Rights Evaluation
projects.summary: Building a self-learning system that evaluates Mac admin rights requests automatically instead of routing every one through a human reviewer.
highlights: Auto-approves at 95%+ confidence and auto-denies at 90%+, routing anything below 85% confidence to a human reviewer
Includes a self-learning loop that logs every human override to improve future confidence scoring
Built entirely with Power Automate and AI Builder, no separate AI infrastructure required
Notifies requestors and reviewers through Teams and tracks every decision in SharePoint

projects.name: Self-Service Prestage Assignment Workflow
projects.summary: Removed direct Jamf console prestage access from support and build teams by giving them an auditable form-based workflow instead.

metrics.label: techs with direct console prestage-edit access

highlights: Built a standalone Power Automate flow paired with Microsoft Forms for serial number + target prestage submissions
Handles the full Jamf scope assignment lifecycle automatically, no console access required
Closed off the most common source of scope misassignment errors at its source
Every change is logged with a complete audit trail, with automated failure visibility via email and Teams alerts

projects.name: Self-Healing Patch Automation
projects.summary: Automated remediation for broken or outdated apps instead of waiting on a ticket.
highlights: Built automated detection and re-install for broken or outdated applications
Reduced failure-related tickets and improved patch reliability fleet-wide

projects.name: Installomator Zero-Touch Deployment
projects.summary: Tied Installomator into our basebuild so app installs are zero-touch, and made sure it holds up across every domain we run.
highlights: Deployed Installomator as part of the standard basebuild for zero-touch app installation
Integrated existing proxy infrastructure so installs work reliably across all 5 domains and AWS

projects.name: Self-Service Restart Notification System
projects.summary: Built a restart notification system that gets users to actually restart when they need to, without spamming them with duplicate prompts.
highlights: LaunchDaemon watcher with escalation logic, so reminders get more insistent the longer a required restart is deferred
Fixed duplicate and stacking notification bugs and rebuilt the last-boot-time parser for accuracy
Restarts trigger off a simple flag file, easy to call from any other script or policy

projects.name: Compliance Dashboard Cleanup
projects.summary: Surfaced the unused scripts, packages, and smart groups quietly causing clutter and 503 errors in Jamf.
highlights: Cross-references scripts, packages, and smart/static groups against active policy assignments
Built a Power BI dashboard to surface anything unused
Unused assets are archived to OneDrive for recordkeeping before automatic removal
Manage the enterprise Mac fleet with Jamf Pro, automating software updates, patching, and compliance monitoring across 10,000+ devices
Deploy and support Jamf Connect for identity authentication across multiple Active Directory domains
Develop automation solutions using Bash, Python, and Power Automate to reduce manual overhead
Script dynamic solutions for admin rights management, reducing IT service tickets
Partner with Apple, Microsoft, and Jamf on change deployments and integrations with minimal disruption
Support incident and root-cause analysis as part of on-call rotations for P1/P2 issues
Document processes and mentor IT support staff for consistency and knowledge transfer
Automated Mac device enrollment using Mosyle, significantly reducing manual work
Built self-service tools for employees to manage approved software
Managed SonicWall firewalls and implemented BitDefender antivirus
Helped launch Windows 365 virtual desktops and documented key workflows
Provided technical support for 750+ users across offices and remote locations
Built internal dashboards to track IT KPIs
Led inventory and office setup projects including video conferencing and VOIP
Supported Mac devices with Jamf and Windows systems via Datto RMM
Deployed antivirus and backup solutions for endpoint security
Participated in response to potential security incidents
Used PowerShell and Confluence for system checks and documentation
Trained support staff on procedures and troubleshooting
